subject: SIG kickoff — Example Health security questionnaire and clarifying asks
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@examplehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG kickoff — Example Health security questionnaire and clarifying asks

Hi Maya — thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, attaching our standard SIG template to get started. A few quick clarifying asks so we can scope the evidence collection and surface any gaps early:  

1) SOC 2 status: are you SOC 2 Type II certified today, in process, or relying on a parent org? If in process, what sprint/cert timeline should we plan to align on evidence?
2) Regulatory scope: will this integration need HIPAA controls (PHI) or GDPR data processing addenda? Which product environments will have customer data (prod only, prod+staging)?
3) Preferred format: does your team prefer SIG spreadsheet vs CAIQ mapping? We can provide a prefilled CAIQ if that helps.
4) Network diagram: could you share a high-level network / architecture diagram (pdf) that we can attach to the SIG?

Next steps I propose: 1) you upload the completed SIG (or tell us preference for CAIQ) 2) we map the asks to evidence and return a prioritized list with deadlines 3) if a BAA is needed we can route DocuSign.

Attachment: ExampleHealth_SIG_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | (415) 555-0184

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for production LLMs

From: Maya Patel <m.patel@examplehealth.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff — Example Health security questionnaire and clarifying asks

Hi Vivek — thanks for the recap and the SIG. I'm attaching a prefilled copy with the questions our security team answered this morning. Quick answers inline:

- SOC 2: in process (remediation complete, audit scheduled for Sep 2027). We do not have a parent org cert.
- Regulatory: HIPAA applies for the workflows we discussed (patient identifiers + notes). GDPR applies for EU-resident patients — we'll need a DPA.
- Format: SIG spreadsheet is fine, we filled that out; CAIQ optional.

We will upload a network diagram (PDF) by EOD Monday. For the BAA, our legal team will need a draft to review — do you have a standard BAA?

Attachment: ExampleHealth_SIG_prefill.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Director, Information Security
Example Health
M: (917) 555-2198
security-ops@examplehealth.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@examplehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff — Example Health security questionnaire and clarifying asks

Hi Maya — perfect, thanks for the prefill and the SOC 2 timing — that helps. A couple follow-ups and notes from our side: 

- BAA: yes, Redwood has a standard BAA we can share. I'll route a DocuSign draft once your legal contact is confirmed.
- Evidence asks: we'll map your SIG answers to the minimum evidence we need (policy docs, control screenshots, configuration exports). Marissa (copied) will own the mapping and send a prioritized evidence list with target due dates.
- HIPAA/GDPR scope: we will treat the integration as covered for PHI and will surface any additional controls we need (e.g., audit logging retention, KMS usage for data at rest).
- Network diagram: once we have your diagram we'll confirm any additional perimeter evidence (firewall rules, VPC peering notes).

Marissa / Jonas — can you pick this up and produce: 1) evidence-mapping-template.xlsx filled with initial asks, 2) a short SOC 2 readiness blurb we can share with Example Health (they asked for an ETA).

Thanks — Vivek

Attachment: evidence-mapping-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks Vivek — picking this up. Quick status and deliverables from Security & Compliance: 

1) SOC 2 readiness: based on their responses, they're "remediation complete" with audit in Sep 2027. We'll state "SOC 2 Type II audit scheduled for Sep 2027; evidence will be limited until post-audit but we can accept control-level artifacts (policies, configuration screenshots, change logs) in the interim."

2) Evidence mapping: attached is a filled evidence-mapping-template.xlsx with suggested priority (P1/P2) for each SIG question and sample evidence types (policy PDF, screenshot, export). I flagged 7 items as P1 where we need screenshots/config exports before integration.

3) BAA: we have a standard BAA template. Vivek — I'll prep the DocuSign envelope. Maya — please confirm the best legal contact for routing (name + email).

4) Network diagram: once they upload the PDF we'll review and ask for any missing ACLs if needed.

Attachments: evidence-mapping-template.xlsx, soc2-readiness-summary.pdf

Next steps (proposed):
- Monday: Example Health uploads network-architecture-diagram.pdf
- Tuesday: Redwood returns prioritized evidence list + expected due dates
- When evidence hits P1 items, schedule a short technical deep-dive with Jonas for any configuration questions

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
